result.summary: Derives the CI CONTAINER_NAME variable automatically from the environment setup filename in ci/test/00_setup_env.sh, removing manual definitions across task-specific environment scripts. It also adjusts a workflow conditional to match the newly derived name for the MSan fuzz task, and removes redundant GOAL="install" definitions and duplicate set -o errexit commands.
result.problem: CI task environment scripts manually define CONTAINER_NAME, which must be unique and present for every run, creating maintenance boilerplate and risking inconsistencies. Several scripts also carry redundant default GOAL="install" assignments and redundant errexit shell options.
evidence: Commit fa8fd9164f states: 'CONTAINER_NAME needs to be set and needs to be unique. Both can be ensured by using the file name.'
result.scope_notes: A mechanical cleanup spanning 29 CI files, stripping CONTAINER_NAME and GOAL="install" lines.
result.card: Automatically derives CONTAINER_NAME in Bitcoin Core CI scripts from the environment config filename in 00_setup_env.sh. This removes manual CONTAINER_NAME definitions across more than 25 CI environment scripts, alongside redundant GOAL=install settings and duplicate set -o errexit invocations. The change simplifies CI maintenance and removes boilerplate without affecting build outputs or user-facing behavior.

risk.why: A typo or incorrect variable derivation could cause CI jobs or conditional runner steps to fail or execute incorrectly.
